استهبلت (form X)
# اِسْتَهْبَلْتُ (istahbaltu) /is.tah.bal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# اِسْتَهْبَلْتَ (istahbalta) /is.tah.bal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# اِسْتَهْبَلْتِ (istahbalti) /is.tah.bal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# اِسْتَهْبَلَتْ (istahbalat) /is.t
